name: Internal Auditor Agent
description: H2A2H enterprise employee agent implementing the Internal Auditor role. The A2A Agent Card provides discovery identity; H2A2H adds delegation, Human responsibility, policy, provenance and Proof-of-Human-Return.

skills.name: Analyze as Internal Auditor
skills.description: Analyze information relevant to the Internal Auditor role and produce evidence-backed findings.

skills.name: Execute Internal Auditor work
skills.description: Execute delegated Internal Auditor work using only the declared tool allowlist and approval policy.

skills.name: Report Internal Auditor outcome
skills.description: Return a structured Internal Auditor result with provenance, audit references and Human-return status.
